lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 bibhaas ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl, Bibhaas:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee vekh too har ma(n)dar terai naal ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, see that the Temple of the Lord is within you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar sabade khojeeai har naamo lehu samhaal ||1||
lines.translation: The Temple of the Lord is found through the Word of the Shabad; contemplate the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere sabad rapai ra(n)g hoi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, be joyfully attuned to the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat sachaa har ma(n)dar pragatee saachee soi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: True is devotional worship, and True is the Temple of the Lord; True is His Manifest Glory. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar ehu sareer hai giaan ratan paragat hoi ||
lines.translation: This body is the Temple of the Lord, in which the jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਾਣਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mool na jaananee maanas har ma(n)dar na hoi ||2||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know anything at all; they do not believe that the Lord's Temple is within. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar har jeeu saajiaa rakhiaa hukam savaar ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord created the Temple of the Lord; He adorns it by His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dhur lekh likhiaa s kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: All act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad cheenhi sukh paaiaa sachai naai piaar ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, peace is obtained, loving the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar sabade sohanaa ka(n)chan kot apaar ||4||
lines.translation: The Temple of the Lord is embellished with the Shabad; it is an Infinite Fortress of God. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੰਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar ehu jagat hai gur bin ghora(n)dhaar ||
lines.translation: This world is the Temple of the Lord; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa bhaau kar poojade manamukh a(n)dh gavaar ||5||
lines.translation: The blind and foolish self-willed manmukhs worship in the love of duality. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਦੇਹ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai deh jaat na jaai ||
lines.translation: One's body and social status do not go along to that place, where all are called to account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saach rate se ubare dukheee doojai bhaai ||6||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; those in the love of duality are miserable. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar mahi naam nidhaan hai naa boojhahi mugadh gavaar ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam is within the Temple of the Lord. The idiotic fools do not realize this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee cheenhiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||7||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have realized this. I keep the Lord enshrined within my heart. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee baanee gur te jaatee j sabad rate ra(n)g laai ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to the love of the Shabad know the Guru, through the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: pavit paavan se jan niramal har kai naam samaai ||8||
lines.translation: Sacred, pure and immaculate are those humble beings who are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਟੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar har kaa haat hai rakhiaa sabad savaar ||
lines.translation: The Temple of the Lord is the Lord's Shop; He embellishes it with the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich saudaa ek naam guramukh lain savaar ||9||
lines.translation: In that shop is the merchandise of the One Name; the Gurmukhs adorn themselves with it. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਹਟੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar mahi man lohat hai mohiaa doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: The mind is like iron slag, within the Temple of the Lord; it is lured by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: paaras bhetiai ka(n)chan bhaiaa keemat kahee na jaai ||10||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, the mind is transformed into gold. Its value cannot be described. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar mahi har vasai sarab nira(n)tar soi ||
lines.translation: The Lord abides within the Temple of the Lord. He is pervading in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh vanajeeai sachaa saudaa hoi ||11||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs trade in the merchandise of Truth. ||11||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bhaai jaage se jan jaagran karahi haumai mail utaar ||
lines.translation: Those who remain awake and aware in the Love and Fear of God, rid themselves of the filth and pollution of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਕਾਢਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa jaagahi ghar apanaa raakhahi pa(n)ch tasakar kaadhahi maar ||1||
lines.translation: They remain awake and aware forever, and protect their homes, by beating and driving out the five thieves. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere guramukh naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit maarag har paaeeai man seee karam kamaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O mind, do only those deeds which will lead you to the Path of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sahaj dhun oopajai dukh haumai vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: The celestial melody wells up in the Gurmukh, and the pains of egotism are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har naamaa har man vasai sahaje har gun gaai ||2||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord abides in the mind, as one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee mukh sohane har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings - their faces are radiant and beautiful. They keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aithai othai sukh ghanaa jap har har utare paar ||3||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, they find absolute peace; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are carried across to the other shore. ||3||
